verdict.rationale: Asana's API and rule-automation platform (task creation, webhooks, rules) could in principle be scripted to perform bulk operations, and AI Studio/no-code automations suggest workflow-level batch actions, but no evidence explicitly describes a bulk/batch API endpoint or multi-item bulk-edit capability. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints, documented multi-item update/delete operations, hands-on confirmation of bulk task management via AI agents.
